title: Welcome to the demo
description: A journey through the UnderCroft app.
script: Welcome to the demo.  UnderCroft is an app to store your personal details such as account, legal documents and who to contact in the event of your demise

title: Sign up
script: UnderCroft supports two roles - an estate owner, and an executor.  For now, lets just get started

title: Enter email and password
script: You can enter your email and a secure password here, then Sign Up

title: UnderCroft joining
script: Here you choose whether you are the estate owner, or an executor with an invite code

title: Estate name
script: Here you add your estate name.  You can change it later in Settings if you want, then Create Estate

title: Main screen
description: Shows all the main sections available
script: This main screen has all the key sections, in one place.  We'll go through these in turn

title: My Letter To You
script: here you can write a letter to anyone you have invited to use the app

title: What to Do First(1)
script: In all the screens, you can change the "Memory" photo with one of your choice.   This screen is a list of things to do

title: What to Do First(2)
description: Second part of What to Do First
script: Here are some steps your executors need to follow, starting off with looking after any pets you may have

title: What to Do First (other steps)
description: Collage of the other steps on the What to Do First
script: There are steps here for medical certficate, death certficate and Tell Us Once.  Plus a Song for the page and a checklist.  Most sections have these two

title: Legal Documents (1)
description: A place to store legal documents.
script: Here you can add copies of the wills

title: Legal Documents (2)
script: Additionally you can add your Title Deeds.  There is also a checklist below the Song for the page

title: Who to Notify (1)
script: Add your contacts here of people you want to be informed - like family, friends, your employer or doctor. There is also information about Life Ledger, a free service you might find useful

title: Who to Notify (2)
script: You can use the Add Organisation button to add key companies that may need contacting - like your bank

title: Who to Notify (3)
script: There is also information about digital subscriptions and Apple Legacy Access

title: Who to Notify (3)
script: Once you have added an Organisation, you can add contact details / help pages and any accounts

title: Running the House
script: Here you can add your favourite tradespeople, and useful information like gas and electrity meters, and the stopcock

title: Funeral Arrangments (1)
script: Here you can add funeral arrangements for everyone in your estate

title: Funeral Arrangments (2)
script: With detail such as your wishes, and any funeral service companies you might want to use

title: Cars
script: This section is useful information about what to do with the cars, in terms of notifying DVLA whether you keep or sell the car

title: Confirmation (1)
script: Confirmation is the rather complicated process to tie up all the loose ends, notifying HMRC and the Sheriff Courts, to finalise the estate

title: Confirmation (2)
script: There are several steps to follow, just an example here for brevity

title: My Songs
script: This section allows you to import and play your own list of songs, maybe for your wake!  There are tools online that can help you create the csv to import from YouTube and others

title: Ad Hoc Data
description: Where you can store extra information to share.
script: For anything else you want to store, like details of your robot lawnmower, you can add via Ad Hoc Data.  You can add multiple Ad Hoc Data sections

title: Settings (1)
script: In Settings you can configure items.  Here you can change the estate name, turn on biometrics like face id and see what the app looks like for your executors

title: Settings (2)
script: Further down, your readiness is shown.  You can invite executors and another estate owner here

title: Settings (3)
script: Further down, your readiness is shown.  You can invite executors and another estate owner.  The invite can be sent via copy, email, share or print

title: Settings (4)
script: Here you can read the privacy policy, or raise a support ticket.  And if you don't want to use the app anymore, deleting your account will delete all the records in your estate, including any executors and other estate owners.  Everything is securely removed
